description: Sync step 2. Render-ready PUBLISHED landing page: content, config, navigation, siteMetadata, assets[] with absolute fileUrl, slotMap, sectionOrder, sitemap, rawHtml for raw-HTML pages, language alternates, plus meta (contentHash, updatedAt, publishedAt, publishedVersionId, path). Full payload, never truncated.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

ifContentHash.description: meta.contentHash from your last export of this item; if unchanged you get { unchanged: true } instead of the body.

version.description: "published" (default) = what is live. "draft" = the editor's current version, for previews only.
